summary: The filing is a press release announcing Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P.'s issuance of C$150 million of 5.75% Cumulative Minimum Rate Reset Class A Preferred Limited Partnership Units (Series 19) at C$25.00 per unit in a bought deal to a syndicate of underwriters. The funds will be used for eligible green investments. This is a routine capital markets financing via a shelf prospectus, not a special situation.
